pairs.rationale_a1: Graphene-CNT grid is a genuine departure but electrochemically unsound: carbon oxidizes at positive float potential; labeled conductivity 100-200 S/m contradicts 'comparable to lead' (~4.8e6 S/m); PbO2 is active material, not merely a corrosion product; 15-year real-time test is not an executable falsification.
pairs.rationale_baseline: Pb-Ca-Si(+Bi/Te) + thicker grid + gel + charge control is near-standard VRLA practice and sound; control arm, EIS, capacity checks present; 131,400 h criterion also impractical but the protocol is concrete.

pairs.rationale_a1: UV-crosslinked EVOH attacks the plasticization root cause, keeps the barrier layer, line-compatible, correct sensitive method (ASTM F1249), n=10, exact constraint conditions; UV chemistry without photoinitiator unproven; '3x reduction' mislabeled as user-stated.
pairs.rationale_baseline: Replacing EVOH with CNC/GO-filled polyolefin likely worsens WVTR (CNC hydrophilic); tortuous-path claim is standard literature; ASTM E96 marginal at <0.5 g/m2/day; 'EN 18120-7' suspect; no sample size; 6mo=18mo equivalence unjustified.

pairs.rationale_a1: Envelope spectral kurtosis cannot be computed from 1 Hz SCADA logs without an unspecified edge-compute leg; 1 kHz bandwidth misses resonance bands; DOI suffix looks fabricated; 30-day window cannot validate 14-day lead or <=2 FA/year; spectral kurtosis is textbook, not a departure.
pairs.rationale_baseline: SEC/power-to-speed drift is computable from existing historian points; correct Nyquist reasoning about the 1 kHz sensor; explicit 3-criterion retrospective kill test incl. noise-floor check; honest evidence limits.

pairs.rationale_a1: PRPD pattern analysis IS standard modern offline PD practice - the 'departure' claim is false; 10 kHz sampling inadequate for PD pulses; 1.5x rated mislabeled user-stated; 3 consecutive outages (~6-9 months) conflicts with the 6-month lead claim; cited DOIs dubious.
pairs.rationale_baseline: IR/PI trending is the most standard offline test; honest about its PD blind spot with kill criteria; but IR/PI is not a PD test (constraint letter) and the IEC 60159 citation is wrong; no sample size.

pairs.rationale_a1: Polyurea encapsulation retrofit respects no-replacement; field adhesion to aged crazed elastomer unproven; 120 MPa shell vs 4 MPa core shear-compliance impact unaddressed; '75 years of accelerated exposure' incoherent; two fabricated user-constraint labels (2 mm drift, 0.05 ppm ozone).
pairs.rationale_baseline: Same polyurea idea plus aramid fibers, but 'replace the bearing pad' violates the core no-replacement constraint; ASTM D573 is heat aging, not ozone (D1149); 6 months ~ 75 years equivalence unjustified; no n; honest evidence caveat.

pairs.rationale_a1: Ionic-liquid/polymer hybrid targets the volatility root cause; explicit 0.5 mm height budget; honest 'value not stated in the cited record' label; ESR penalty vs ACN unaddressed; covalent immobilization vs ion mobility tension; 10-year real-time test not executable.
pairs.rationale_baseline: SPE conductivity too low for EDLC ESR; PCM buffers transients, useless against steady 65 C ambient; KOH mischaracterizes commercial EDLC chemistry; 1000 h @80 C as 10-year proxy has no Arrhenius basis; height claim unbudgeted.

pairs.rationale_a1: 'Ripple std' is not measurable at 1-minute sampling (HF content aliased/averaged out) - the core metric is invalid under the constraint; thesis DOI with precise 0.04-0.06 A_rms claim looks fabricated; brush-material change out of scope; validation has no lead-time or false-alarm kill criteria.
pairs.rationale_baseline: Contact resistance Rc=V/I from existing sensors is computable; load-normalized dual threshold; 12-month retrospective kill test against BOTH constraints; honest evidence filtering.

pairs.rationale_a1: CAT needs refrigerant saturation pressure - not in the allowed BMS list; 97%-of-95% baseline arithmetic muddled; 5 C baseline mislabeled user constraint; validation lacks wet-bulb/load normalization; approach monitoring is standard practice, not a departure.
pairs.rationale_baseline: Fouling resistance R_f is standard but sound; split-season A/B with wet-bulb normalization; three explicit falsification criteria incl. 3% energy and cost payback; honest about irrelevant evidence and the part-load caveat.

pairs.rationale_a1: PEO-LiTFSI in the cathode (1e-5 S/cm) adds resistance, cannot homogenize transport; plating/stripping is an anode phenomenon mislocated in the cathode; test relaxes the MAX-spread constraint to '35% of cells'; 10-year real-time; novel but physically inverted.
pairs.rationale_baseline: Attacks the thermal root cause; PCM alone is transient-only but the graphite conduction path legitimately reduces the gradient; executable gradient-chamber falsification with the exact 35 mV criterion; footprint/balancer constraints respected; honest evidence filtering.

pairs.rationale_a1: Invents a second top-oil sensor and nanofluid oil - both violate 'existing sensors only'; 0.5 C/cm over 1 m = 50 C top-oil difference is physically absurd; PD micro-arc heat is undetectable in top-oil; claims 'no new hardware' falsely.
pairs.rationale_baseline: Requires a NEW online gas sensor - violates the same constraint; but gas-rate physics is sound and the accelerated-aging lab falsification is concrete; claims 'repurposing existing data streams' falsely.

gate.definition: Art. LXXXVI: mean novelty delta >= 0.5 AND mean feasibility gap <= 0.25, auditor-judged on >= 10 pairs; format wins excluded
